headline: Introduces bag and icon scale options, pixel-perfect alignment, and scroll bar fixes for BetterBags Next.

entries.title: Bag and icon scale options in Next appearance settings
entries.details: The Appearance settings window now includes a Size tab for BetterBags Next with Icon Scale and Bag Scale sliders. Icon Scale lets you resize item buttons to fit more or fewer items per row, while Bag Scale resizes small bag panels while preserving docking, dragging, and chaining.

entries.title: Pixel-perfect rendering in BetterBags Next
entries.details: BetterBags Next panels, borders, fonts, and icons now align to whole screen pixels. This prevents thin borders from disappearing or appearing blurry across different screen resolutions and UI scales.

entries.title: Scroll bar thumb clicks grabbing list rows in Next
entries.details: Fixed an issue in BetterBags Next scrollable views, including the category list in settings, where clicking or dragging the scroll bar thumb would mistakenly click or drag the content row underneath it.
